test_title: PYST 42: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: 24 men can complete a work in 15 days. How many men are needed to complete the same work in 10 days?
solution:
**Given:**

24 men can complete a work in 15 days

**Concept Used:**

(M1 × D1) = (M2 × D2)

M1 = Initial men, D1 = Initial day, M₂ = Final men, D₂ = Final day

**Calculation:**

⇒ (M₁ × D₁) = (M₂ × D₂)

⇒ 24 × 15 = M2 × 10

⇒ M2 = 36

**Therefore, 36 men will complete the same work in 10 days.**
